title: Elodie and the Vector
author: Orsen Thackeray
blurb: Zephyrine Ravensworth, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
